note: Use only for the documented Sola Sound-supplied production period; later Jennings-made examples remain separate.
Short Jennings-manufactured period begins in November 1968 according to surviving historical evidence summarized by Fuzzboxes.
Early SupaFuzzes were supplied by Sola Sound through 1968.
Marshall took over production in 1968 and continued the model into the 1970s.
Some early cast-enclosure and Tone Bender MKII Zonk II examples were supplied by Sola Sound.
Later folded-aluminium Zonk II PCBs identify Wilsic Sound as builder for Hornby Skewes.
Pre-partnership manufacture is historically reported but no surviving pre-WEM example is known.
WEM later took over production, with long-red WEM-built enclosures documenting the later phase.
